**Self-check** — the entry is included only if all five pass:

- [ ] **Real** — it exists and does what it claims (repo runs / paper published / spec official).
- [ ] **Reachable** — canonical, first-party URL; loads without login.
- [ ] **Relevant** — genuinely about agent reliability, not adjacent hype.
- [ ] **Non-redundant** — adds something no listed entry does (name the distinct capability below).
- [ ] **Honest** — the description names real limitations; no marketing language.
